subject: MAP: Testing playbook & acceptance checklist for eval materials
messages:
From: Clara Jensen <clara@graybridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exchange of eval materials + MAP proposal

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput numbers look very promising for our real-world workloads. Wed like to accelerate a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can exchange test artifacts (datasets, prompt packs, and test cases) and close by the end of the quarter.

High level asks from our side:
- We will provide a redacted sample corpus and 3 prompt packs (generation, summarization, safety). attached: graybridge-eval-asset-list.csv (file list + sensitivity tags).
- Need a committed staging window (IP allowlist + temporary S3 access) and an acceptance checklist so our legal and security teams can sign off quickly.
- Key constraints: no redistribution of raw prompts/datasets, 30-day retention for raw data on staging, and audit logs retained for 90 days.

Proposed timeline: provide assets on Mon Nov 23, Redwood to stand up staging and ingest by Nov 30, mutual acceptance test finished by Dec 14, final contract/DocuSign by Dec 21.

Can you confirm the MAP milestones and the usage constraints above or propose edits? If helpful I can loop in Legal (cc'ed).

Thanks,
Clara
Clara Jensen
Head of ML Ops, Graybridge AI
clara@graybridge.ai

Attachments: graybridge-eval-asset-list.csv (CSV, 42 rows: dataset id, sensitivity, sample_size)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara@graybridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials + MAP proposal

Clara, thanks for the clear summary and timeline. Were aligned on moving quickly. A few clarifications and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Draft MAP + acceptance checklist: attached redwood-MAP-draft.pdf. It contains milestone names (Assets Delivered, Ingest & Sanity, Acceptance Tests, Final Signoff) and explicit criteria for pass/fail on the acceptance tests.
2) Security constraints: we can support 30-day retention in the Redwood staging environment; audit logs available for 90 days; access via temporary S3 pre-signed links and IP allowlist. Any additional KMS/HSM requirements should be noted now.
3) Access provisioning: to reduce ingestion friction, please add a minimal sample (<=1k rows per dataset) and a readme that lists expected tokenization characteristics (avg tokens per prompt).
4) DocuSign: I'll send the MAP and a limited-data addendum via DocuSign once legal confirms the MPA language. Link will be included in my next message.

Proposed refined timeline (we can update after you deliver assets):
- Nov 23: Graybridge delivers assets + usage constraints document
- Nov 24-27: Redwood security review + ingest prep
- Nov 30: Staging environment available, initial ingest complete
- Dec 7: Acceptance tests run by both teams (two rounds)
- Dec 14: Mutual acceptance decision
- Dec 21: DocuSign complete and access turned over to your production team (if applicable)

We're also happy to commit a short SLA window for the staging jobs to prioritize your acceptance tests (low-latency batch queues).

On the technical side I've cc'd Dev (dev_patel) for an ingestion checklist and tokenization guidance.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP draft, 4 pages)

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Jensen <clara@graybridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials + MAP proposal

Looping in some technical constraints and recommendations for the ingestion phase. Ive attached a small checklist (redwood-ingestion-checklist.md) we use to avoid common regressions. Highlights: 
- Please include a short sample (<=1000 examples) with the "worst-case" prompt lengths and a small metric file (expected output tokens) so we can size KV cache and batching correctly.
- Tokenization note: if prompts contain mixed UTF-8 emoji or non-Latin scripts, include a tokenization mapping to avoid surprises in sequence length distribution.
- For safety tests: provide label schema and a small goldset (50 examples) so our eval harness can compute precision/recall consistently.
- Data handling: Redwoods staging ingestion will mount a non-persistent volume for raw uploads; derived artifacts (tokenized indexes, precomputed embeddings) will be retained per the 30-day policy and purged automatically after that window.

Operational ask: please create one contact for SCIM/API creds provisioning and one contact for legal questions. That keeps the MAP responsibilities clear.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-ingestion-checklist.md (text, 12 items)

From: Clara Jensen <clara@graybridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Intake <legal@graybridge.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials + MAP proposal

Thanks Naomi / Dev — this looks good and actionable. A few follow-ups and a small edit to the MAP: 

- Usage constraints: our legal team requires explicit "no redistribution" language and an express prohibition on using the raw prompts/datasets to train commercial models outside of the agreed testing window. Weve put that language into an attached short PDF (graybridge-usage-constraints.pdf). Please confirm Redwood can sign to those limits.
- Retention: 30-day retention for raw uploads is acceptable. Can you confirm the purge process is auditable (we need timestamps and who/what triggered the purge)?
- Acceptance criteria: wed like an additional acceptance item for a reproducible evaluation script that both teams can run (repo link or a small runner). That should be in scope for the acceptance tests before Dec 14.

Quoted for context:
> On Nov 20, 2026, at 11:34 AM, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com> wrote:
> 
> Clara, thanks for the clear summary and timeline. Were aligned on moving quickly. A few clarifications and next steps from Redwood:
> 
> 1) Draft MAP + acceptance checklist: attached redwood-MAP-draft.pdf. It contains milestone names (Assets Delivered, Ingest & Sanity, Acceptance Tests, Final Signoff) and explicit criteria for pass/fail on the acceptance tests.
> 2) Security constraints: we can support 30-day retention in the Redwood staging environment; audit logs available for 90 days; access via temporary S3 pre-signed links and IP allowlist. Any additional KMS/HSM requirements should be noted now.

We can sign to the no-redistribution and no-training clauses as long as the data purge is auditable and logs are available; please share the DocuSign link once youve incorporated the usage constraints into the MAP.

Ill also create a small branch with a reproducible runner for the acceptance tests and share the repo link by Nov 27.

Best,
Clara Jensen
Head of ML Ops, Graybridge AI

Attachments: graybridge-usage-constraints.pdf (short form constraints, 2 pages)
